raw_message.reasoning:
unique_in_window seems correct. But requirement R8 says ensure each item only yielded if not appeared in most recent window of size n. Current implementation uses set of keys; if k in uniques continue. But it discards oldest when window full. That matches spec. Good.

Now need to implement new functions: relative_seek, combination_with_replacement_index, nth_combination_with_replacement, polynomial_eval, polynomial_derivative, sum_of_squares, iterate, maybe adjust partial_product, and expose in __all__ of recipes and more.

Also need to update __all__ in more.py? It already includes many functions. The new ones should be added to __all__ there too.

Also need to update __version__ to 10.0.0.

Also need to expose these new functions from top-level module. Since __init__ imports recipes and more, adding to __all__ there will expose.

Implement in recipes.py for functions that belong there: relative_seek, polynomial_eval, polynomial_derivative, sum_of_squares, iterate. Also nth_combination_with_replacement and combination_with_replacement_index maybe in more.py? They are more general combinatorial functions; but tests refer to mi.combination_index etc. They might be in more.py. The requirement R2 mentions combination_index etc should return zero-based index. Those already exist. We need to add combination_with_replacement_index and product_index already exists. Also nth_combination_with_replacement; tests likely refer to mi.nth_combination_with_replacement. Let's search.
